verses.textZh: 哈巴谷先知所得的默示。
verses.textZhCnvs: 哈巴谷先知所得的默示。
verses.textZhCuv: 先知哈巴谷所得的默示。
verses.textEnNiv: The prophecy that Habakkuk the prophet received.
verses.textEnEsv: The oracle that Habakkuk the prophet saw.
verses.textEnNkjv: The burden which the prophet Habakkuk saw.
verses.textEnNlt: This is the message that the prophet Habakkuk received in a vision.
verses.textEnNasb: The pronouncement which Habakkuk the prophet saw:
verses.textEn: The prophecy that Habakkuk the prophet received.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！ 我恳求，你不垂听， 要到几时呢？ 我向你呼叫"有狂暴的事"，你却不拯救。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！ 我恳求，你不垂听， 要到几时呢？ 我向你呼叫"有狂暴的事"，你却不拯救。
verses.textZhCuv: 他说：耶和华啊！我呼求你， 你不应允，要到几时呢？ 我因强暴哀求你，你还不拯救。
verses.textEnNiv: How long, Lord , must I call for help, but you do not listen? Or cry out to you, "Violence!" but you do not save?
verses.textEnEsv: O Lord , how long shall I cry for help, and you will not hear? Or cry to you "Violence!" and you will not save?
verses.textEnNkjv: O Lord, how long shall I cry, And You will not hear? Even cry out to You, "Violence!" And You will not save.
verses.textEnNlt: How long, O Lord , must I call for help? But you do not listen! "Violence is everywhere!" I cry, but you do not come to save.
verses.textEnNasb: How long, Lord, have I called for help, And You do not hear? I cry out to You, "Violence!" Yet You do not save.
verses.textEn: How long, Lord , must I call for help, but you do not listen? Or cry out to you, "Violence!" but you do not save?

verses.textZh: 你为甚么使我看见恶行？ 有奸恶的事，你为甚么见而不理？ 毁灭和强暴在我面前， 纷争和相斗常常发生。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你为甚么使我看见恶行？ 有奸恶的事，你为甚么见而不理？ 毁灭和强暴在我面前， 纷争和相斗常常发生。
verses.textZhCuv: 你为何使我看见罪孽？ 你为何看着奸恶而不理呢？ 毁灭和强暴在我面前， 又起了争端和相斗的事。
verses.textEnNiv: Why do you make me look at injustice? Why do you tolerate wrongdoing? Destruction and violence are before me; there is strife, and conflict abounds.
verses.textEnEsv: Why do you make me see iniquity, and why do you idly look at wrong? Destruction and violence are before me; strife and contention arise.
verses.textEnNkjv: Why do You show me iniquity, And cause me to see trouble? For plundering and violence are before me; There is strife, and contention arises.
verses.textEnNlt: Must I forever see these evil deeds? Why must I watch all this misery? Wherever I look, I see destruction and violence. I am surrounded by people who love to argue and fight.
verses.textEnNasb: Why do You make me see disaster, And make me look at destitution? Yes, devastation and violence are before me; Strife exists and contention arises.
verses.textEn: Why do you make me look at injustice? Why do you tolerate wrongdoing? Destruction and violence are before me; there is strife, and conflict abounds.

verses.textZh: 因此律法不能生效 ， 公理无法彰显。 因为恶人把义人包围，所以公理颠倒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此律法不能生效 ， 公理无法彰显。 因为恶人把义人包围，所以公理颠倒。
verses.textZhCuv: 因此律法放松， 公理也不显明； 恶人围困义人， 所以公理显然颠倒。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore the law is paralyzed, and justice never prevails. The wicked hem in the righteous, so that justice is perverted.
verses.textEnEsv: So the law is paralyzed, and justice never goes forth. For the wicked surround the righteous; so justice goes forth perverted.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore the law is powerless, And justice never goes forth. For the wicked surround the righteous; Therefore perverse judgment proceeds.
verses.textEnNlt: The law has become paralyzed, and there is no justice in the courts. The wicked far outnumber the righteous, so that justice has become perverted.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore the Law is ignored, And justice is never upheld. For the wicked surround the righteous; Therefore justice comes out confused.
verses.textEn: Therefore the law is paralyzed, and justice never prevails. The wicked hem in the righteous, so that justice is perverted.

verses.textZh: 你们当看列国，要定睛观看，就会大大惊奇， 因为在你们的日子，我要作一件事， 即使有人说了出来，你们也不会相信。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们当看列国，要定睛观看，就会大大惊奇， 因为在你们的日子，我要作一件事， 即使有人说了出来，你们也不会相信。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：你们要向列国中观看， 大大惊奇； 因为在你们的时候，我行一件事， 虽有人告诉你们，你们总是不信。
verses.textEnNiv: "Look at the nations and watch— and be utterly amazed. For I am going to do something in your days that you would not believe, even if you were told.
verses.textEnEsv: "Look among the nations, and see; wonder and be astounded. For I am doing a work in your days that you would not believe if told.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Look among the nations and watch— Be utterly astounded! For Iwill work a work in your days Which you would not believe, though it were told you.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord replied, "Look around at the nations; look and be amazed! For I am doing something in your own day, something you wouldn’t believe even if someone told you about it.
verses.textEnNasb: "Look among the nations! Watch! Be horrified! Be frightened speechless! For I am accomplishing a work in your days— You would not believe it even if you were told!
verses.textEn: "Look at the nations and watch— and be utterly amazed. For I am going to do something in your days that you would not believe, even if you were told.

verses.textZh: 就是要兴起迦勒底人，那残忍凶暴的民； 他们遍行全地，占领别人的家园。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就是要兴起迦勒底人，那残忍凶暴的民； 他们遍行全地，占领别人的家园。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必兴起迦勒底人， 就是那残忍暴躁之民，通行遍地， 占据那不属自己的住处。
verses.textEnNiv: I am raising up the Babylonians, that ruthless and impetuous people, who sweep across the whole earth to seize dwellings not their own.
verses.textEnEsv: For behold, I am raising up the Chaldeans, that bitter and hasty nation, who march through the breadth of the earth, to seize dwellings not their own.
verses.textEnNkjv: For indeed I am raising up the Chaldeans, A bitter and hasty nation Which marches through the breadth of the earth, To possess dwelling places thatare not theirs.
verses.textEnNlt: I am raising up the Babylonians, a cruel and violent people. They will march across the world and conquer other lands.
verses.textEnNasb: "For behold, I am raising up the Chaldeans, That grim and impetuous people Who march throughout the earth, To take possession of dwelling places that are not theirs.
verses.textEn: I am raising up the Babylonians, that ruthless and impetuous people, who sweep across the whole earth to seize dwellings not their own.

verses.textZh: 他们恐怖可怕，自以为义，趾高气扬。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们恐怖可怕，自以为义，趾高气扬。
verses.textZhCuv: 他威武可畏， 判断和势力都任意发出。
verses.textEnNiv: They are a feared and dreaded people; they are a law to themselves and promote their own honor.
verses.textEnEsv: They are dreaded and fearsome; their justice and dignity go forth from themselves.
verses.textEnNkjv: They are terrible and dreadful; Their judgment and their dignity proceed from themselves.
verses.textEnNlt: They are notorious for their cruelty and do whatever they like.
verses.textEnNasb: "They are terrifying and feared; Their justice and authority originate with themselves.
verses.textEn: They are a feared and dreaded people; they are a law to themselves and promote their own honor.

verses.textZh: 他们的马比豹更快，比晚上的豺狼更猛。 他们的骑兵奔驰，自远而来； 他们如鹰飞翔，迅速吞噬。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们的马比豹更快，比晚上的豺狼更猛。 他们的骑兵奔驰，自远而来； 他们如鹰飞翔，迅速吞噬。
verses.textZhCuv: 他的马比豹更快， 比晚上的豺狼更猛。 马兵踊跃争先， 都从远方而来； 他们飞跑如鹰抓食，
verses.textEnNiv: Their horses are swifter than leopards, fiercer than wolves at dusk. Their cavalry gallops headlong; their horsemen come from afar. They fly like an eagle swooping to devour;
verses.textEnEsv: Their horses are swifter than leopards, more fierce than the evening wolves; their horsemen press proudly on. Their horsemen come from afar; they fly like an eagle swift to devour.
verses.textEnNkjv: Their horses also are swifter than leopards, And more fierce than evening wolves. Their chargers charge ahead; Their cavalry comes from afar; They fly as the eagle that hastens to eat.
verses.textEnNlt: Their horses are swifter than cheetahs and fiercer than wolves at dusk. Their charioteers charge from far away. Like eagles, they swoop down to devour their prey.
verses.textEnNasb: "Their horses are faster than leopards, And quicker than wolves in the evening. Their horsemen charge along, Their horsemen come from afar; They fly like an eagle swooping down to devour.
verses.textEn: Their horses are swifter than leopards, fiercer than wolves at dusk. Their cavalry gallops headlong; their horsemen come from afar. They fly like an eagle swooping to devour;

verses.textZh: 他们定着脸面向前，齐来行暴， 掳获战俘多如尘沙。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们定着脸面向前，齐来行暴， 掳获战俘多如尘沙。
verses.textZhCuv: 都为行强暴而来， 定住脸面向前， 将掳掠的人聚集，多如尘沙。
verses.textEnNiv: they all come intent on violence. Their hordes advance like a desert wind and gather prisoners like sand.
verses.textEnEsv: They all come for violence, all their faces forward. They gather captives like sand.
verses.textEnNkjv: "They all come for violence; Their faces are set like the east wind. They gather captives like sand.
verses.textEnNlt: "On they come, all bent on violence. Their hordes advance like a desert wind, sweeping captives ahead of them like sand.
verses.textEnNasb: "All of them come for violence. Their horde of faces moves forward. They gather captives like sand.
verses.textEn: they all come intent on violence. Their hordes advance like a desert wind and gather prisoners like sand.

verses.textZh: 他们戏弄君王，以掌权的为笑柄； 他们嗤笑一切城堡，筑垒攻取；
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们戏弄君王，以掌权的为笑柄； 他们嗤笑一切城堡，筑垒攻取；
verses.textZhCuv: 他们讥诮君王，笑话首领， 嗤笑一切保障，筑垒攻取。
verses.textEnNiv: They mock kings and scoff at rulers. They laugh at all fortified cities; by building earthen ramps they capture them.
verses.textEnEsv: At kings they scoff, and at rulers they laugh. They laugh at every fortress, for they pile up earth and take it.
verses.textEnNkjv: They scoff at kings, And princes are scorned by them. They deride every stronghold, For they heap up earthen mounds and seize it.
verses.textEnNlt: They scoff at kings and princes and scorn all their fortresses. They simply pile ramps of earth against their walls and capture them!
verses.textEnNasb: "They make fun of kings, And dignitaries are an object of laughter to them. They laugh at every fortress, Then heap up dirt and capture it.
verses.textEn: They mock kings and scoff at rulers. They laugh at all fortified cities; by building earthen ramps they capture them.

verses.textZh: 然后扫荡如风吹过。 他们是有罪的，因他们以自己的势力为神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然后扫荡如风吹过。 他们是有罪的，因他们以自己的势力为神。
verses.textZhCuv: 他以自己的势力为神， 像风猛然扫过，显为有罪。
verses.textEnNiv: Then they sweep past like the wind and go on— guilty people, whose own strength is their god."
verses.textEnEsv: Then they sweep by like the wind and go on, guilty men, whose own might is their god!"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then his mind changes, and he transgresses; He commits offense, Ascribing this power to his god."
verses.textEnNlt: They sweep past like the wind and are gone. But they are deeply guilty, for their own strength is their god."
verses.textEnNasb: "Then they fly along like the wind and pass on. But they will be held guilty, They whose strength is their god."
verses.textEn: Then they sweep past like the wind and go on— guilty people, whose own strength is their god."

verses.textZh: 耶和华我的神，我的圣者啊！ 你不是自古就有的吗？我们不会死的。 耶和华啊！你派他们行审判。 盘石啊！你立他们施惩罚。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华我的神，我的圣者啊！ 你不是自古就有的吗？我们不会死的。 耶和华啊！你派他们行审判。 盘石啊！你立他们施惩罚。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华－我的神，我的圣者啊， 你不是从亘古而有吗？ 我们必不致死。 耶和华啊，你派定他为要刑罚人； 磐石啊，你设立他为要惩治人。
verses.textEnNiv: Lord , are you not from everlasting? My God, my Holy One, you will never die. You, Lord , have appointed them to execute judgment; you, my Rock, have ordained them to punish.
verses.textEnEsv: Are you not from everlasting, O Lord my God, my Holy One? We shall not die. O Lord , you have ordained them as a judgment, and you, O Rock, have established them for reproof.
verses.textEnNkjv: Are You not from everlasting, O Lord my God, my Holy One? We shall not die. O Lord, You have appointed them for judgment; O Rock, You have marked them for correction.
verses.textEnNlt: O Lord my God, my Holy One, you who are eternal— surely you do not plan to wipe us out? O Lord , our Rock, you have sent these Babylonians to correct us, to punish us for our many sins.
verses.textEnNasb: Are You not from time everlasting, Lord, my God, my Holy One? We will not die. You, Lord, have appointed them to deliver judgment; And You, O Rock, have destined them to punish.
verses.textEn: Lord , are you not from everlasting? My God, my Holy One, you will never die. You, Lord , have appointed them to execute judgment; you, my Rock, have ordained them to punish.

verses.textZh: 你的眼目纯洁，不看邪恶， 不能坐视奸恶； 为甚么见行诡诈的人而不理？ 恶人吞灭比自己公义的人，你为甚么缄默呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的眼目纯洁，不看邪恶， 不能坐视奸恶； 为甚么见行诡诈的人而不理？ 恶人吞灭比自己公义的人，你为甚么缄默呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 你眼目清洁， 不看邪僻，不看奸恶； 行诡诈的，你为何看着不理呢？ 恶人吞灭比自己公义的， 你为何静默不语呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Your eyes are too pure to look on evil; you cannot tolerate wrongdoing. Why then do you tolerate the treacherous? Why are you silent while the wicked swallow up those more righteous than themselves?
verses.textEnEsv: You who are of purer eyes than to see evil and cannot look at wrong, why do you idly look at traitors and remain silent when the wicked swallows up the man more righteous than he?
verses.textEnNkjv: Youare of purer eyes than to behold evil, And cannot look on wickedness. Why do You look on those who deal treacherously, And hold Your tongue when the wicked devours A person more righteous than he?
verses.textEnNlt: But you are pure and cannot stand the sight of evil. Will you wink at their treachery? Should you be silent while the wicked swallow up people more righteous than they?
verses.textEnNasb: Your eyes are too pure to look at evil, And You cannot look at harm favorably. Why do You look favorably At those who deal treacherously? Why are You silent when the wicked swallow up Those more righteous than they?
verses.textEn: Your eyes are too pure to look on evil; you cannot tolerate wrongdoing. Why then do you tolerate the treacherous? Why are you silent while the wicked swallow up those more righteous than themselves?

verses.textZh: 你竟使人像海里的鱼， 像无人管辖的爬行的动物。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你竟使人像海里的鱼， 像无人管辖的爬行的动物。
verses.textZhCuv: 你为何使人如海中的鱼， 又如没有管辖的爬物呢？
verses.textEnNiv: You have made people like the fish in the sea, like the sea creatures that have no ruler.
verses.textEnEsv: You make mankind like the fish of the sea, like crawling things that have no ruler.
verses.textEnNkjv: Why do You make men like fish of the sea, Like creeping things thathave no ruler over them?
verses.textEnNlt: Are we only fish to be caught and killed? Are we only sea creatures that have no leader?
verses.textEnNasb: Why have You made people like the fish of the sea, Like crawling things that have no ruler over them?
verses.textEn: You have made people like the fish in the sea, like the sea creatures that have no ruler.

verses.textZh: 迦勒底人既用钩把他们钓起来，用网拖走， 用鱼网收聚在一处，就欢喜快乐，
verses.textZhCnvs: 迦勒底人既用钩把他们钓起来，用网拖走， 用鱼网收聚在一处，就欢喜快乐，
verses.textZhCuv: 他用钩钩住，用网捕获， 用拉网聚集他们； 因此，他欢喜快乐，
verses.textEnNiv: The wicked foe pulls all of them up with hooks, he catches them in his net, he gathers them up in his dragnet; and so he rejoices and is glad.
verses.textEnEsv: He brings all of them up with a hook; he drags them out with his net; he gathers them in his dragnet; so he rejoices and is glad.
verses.textEnNkjv: They take up all of them with a hook, They catch them in their net, And gather them in their dragnet. Therefore they rejoice and are glad.
verses.textEnNlt: Must we be strung up on their hooks and caught in their nets while they rejoice and celebrate?
verses.textEnNasb: The Chaldeans bring all of them up with a hook, Drag them away with their net, And gather them together in their fishing net. Therefore they rejoice and are joyful.
verses.textEn: The wicked foe pulls all of them up with hooks, he catches them in his net, he gathers them up in his dragnet; and so he rejoices and is glad.

verses.textZh: 向自己的网献祭，对鱼网烧香， 因他们藉此收获丰富，饮食充裕。
verses.textZhCnvs: 向自己的网献祭，对鱼网烧香， 因他们藉此收获丰富，饮食充裕。
verses.textZhCuv: 就向网献祭，向网烧香， 因他由此得肥美的分和富裕的食物。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore he sacrifices to his net and burns incense to his dragnet, for by his net he lives in luxury and enjoys the choicest food.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore he sacrifices to his net and makes offerings to his dragnet; for by them he lives in luxury, and his food is rich.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore they sacrifice to their net, And burn incense to their dragnet; Because by them their share is sumptuous And their food plentiful.
verses.textEnNlt: Then they will worship their nets and burn incense in front of them. "These nets are the gods who have made us rich!" they will claim.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore they offer a sacrifice to their net And burn incense to their fishing net, Because through these things their catch is large, And their food is plentiful.
verses.textEn: Therefore he sacrifices to his net and burns incense to his dragnet, for by his net he lives in luxury and enjoys the choicest food.

verses.textZh: 这样，他们倒空自己的网， 毫不留情地继续杀戮列国。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，他们倒空自己的网， 毫不留情地继续杀戮列国。
verses.textZhCuv: 他岂可屡次倒空网罗， 将列国的人时常杀戮，毫不顾惜呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Is he to keep on emptying his net, destroying nations without mercy?
verses.textEnEsv: Is he then to keep on emptying his net and mercilessly killing nations forever?
verses.textEnNkjv: Shall they therefore empty their net, And continue to slay nations without pity?
verses.textEnNlt: Will you let them get away with this forever? Will they succeed forever in their heartless conquests?
verses.textEnNasb: Will they therefore empty their net, And continually slay nations without sparing?
verses.textEn: Is he to keep on emptying his net, destroying nations without mercy?

verses.textZh: 我要站在哨岗，立在城楼， 留心看耶和华在我里面说甚么， 怎样使我答复自己的怨诉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要站在哨岗，立在城楼， 留心看耶和华在我里面说甚么， 怎样使我答复自己的怨诉。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要站在守望所， 立在望楼上观看， 看耶和华对我说什么话， 我可用什么话向他诉冤 。
verses.textEnNiv: I will stand at my watch and station myself on the ramparts; I will look to see what he will say to me, and what answer I am to give to this complaint.
verses.textEnEsv: I will take my stand at my watchpost and station myself on the tower, and look out to see what he will say to me, and what I will answer concerning my complaint.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will stand my watch And set myself on the rampart, And watch to see what He will say to me, And what I will answer when I am corrected.
verses.textEnNlt: I will climb up to my watchtower and stand at my guardpost. There I will wait to see what the Lord says and how he will answer my complaint.
verses.textEnNasb: I will stand at my guard post And station myself on the watchtower; And I will keep watch to see what He will say to me, And how I may reply when I am reprimanded.
verses.textEn: I will stand at my watch and station myself on the ramparts; I will look to see what he will say to me, and what answer I am to give to this complaint.

verses.textZh: 耶和华回答我说： "把异象写下，清楚地记在泥版上， 使读的人容易明白，
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华回答我说： "把异象写下，清楚地记在泥版上， 使读的人容易明白，
verses.textZhCuv: 他对我说：将这默示明明地写在版上， 使读的人容易读 。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord replied: "Write down the revelation and make it plain on tablets so that a herald may run with it.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord answered me: "Write the vision; make it plain on tablets, so he may run who reads it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord answered me and said: "Write the vision And make it plain on tablets, That he may run who reads it.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said to me, "Write my answer plainly on tablets, so that a runner can carry the correct message to others.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord answered me and said, "Write down the vision And inscribe it clearly on tablets, So that one who reads it may run.
verses.textEn: Then the Lord replied: "Write down the revelation and make it plain on tablets so that a herald may run with it.

verses.textZh: 因这异象关乎一定的日期， 很快就要实现，决不徒然；纵有迟延，仍当等候， 因为它一定会来到，绝不耽误。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因这异象关乎一定的日期， 很快就要实现，决不徒然；纵有迟延，仍当等候， 因为它一定会来到，绝不耽误。"
verses.textZhCuv: 因为这默示有一定的日期， 快要应验，并不虚谎。 虽然迟延，还要等候； 因为必然临到，不再迟延。
verses.textEnNiv: For the revelation awaits an appointed time; it speaks of the end and will not prove false. Though it linger, wait for it; it will certainly come and will not delay.
verses.textEnEsv: For still the vision awaits its appointed time; it hastens to the end—it will not lie. If it seems slow, wait for it; it will surely come; it will not delay.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the vision is yet for an appointed time; But at the end it will speak, and it will not lie. Though it tarries, wait for it; Because it will surely come, It will not tarry.
verses.textEnNlt: This vision is for a future time. It describes the end, and it will be fulfilled. If it seems slow in coming, wait patiently, for it will surely take place. It will not be delayed.
verses.textEnNasb: "For the vision is yet for the appointed time; It hurries toward the goal and it will not fail. Though it delays, wait for it; For it will certainly come, it will not delay long.
verses.textEn: For the revelation awaits an appointed time; it speaks of the end and will not prove false. Though it linger, wait for it; it will certainly come and will not delay.

verses.textZh: 迦勒底人自高自大，心不正直； 然而义人必因信得生 。
verses.textZhCnvs: 迦勒底人自高自大，心不正直； 然而义人必因信得生 。
verses.textZhCuv: 迦勒底人自高自大，心不正直； 惟义人因信得生。
verses.textEnNiv: "See, the enemy is puffed up; his desires are not upright— but the righteous person will live by his faithfulness —
verses.textEnEsv: "Behold, his soul is puffed up; it is not upright within him, but the righteous shall live by his faith.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Behold the proud, His soul is not upright in him; But the just shall live by his faith.
verses.textEnNlt: "Look at the proud! They trust in themselves, and their lives are crooked. But the righteous will live by their faithfulness to God.
verses.textEnNasb: "Behold, as for the impudent one, His soul is not right within him; But the righteous one will live by his faith.
verses.textEn: "See, the enemy is puffed up; his desires are not upright— but the righteous person will live by his faithfulness —

verses.textZh: 财富 使人奸诈狂傲，不得安宁； 扩张欲望，如同阴间； 又像死亡，永不满足。 他们招聚万国，集合万民，都归自己。
verses.textZhCnvs: 财富 使人奸诈狂傲，不得安宁； 扩张欲望，如同阴间； 又像死亡，永不满足。 他们招聚万国，集合万民，都归自己。
verses.textZhCuv: 迦勒底人因酒诡诈，狂傲， 不住在家中， 扩充心欲，好像阴间。 他如死不能知足， 聚集万国，堆积万民都归自己。
verses.textEnNiv: indeed, wine betrays him; he is arrogant and never at rest. Because he is as greedy as the grave and like death is never satisfied, he gathers to himself all the nations and takes captive all the peoples.
verses.textEnEsv: "Moreover, wine is a traitor, an arrogant man who is never at rest. His greed is as wide as Sheol; like death he has never enough. He gathers for himself all nations and collects as his own all peoples."
verses.textEnNkjv: "Indeed, because he transgresses by wine, Heis a proud man, And he does not stay at home. Because he enlarges his desire as hell, And he is like death, and cannot be satisfied, He gathers to himself all nations And heaps up for himself all peoples.
verses.textEnNlt: Wealth is treacherous, and the arrogant are never at rest. They open their mouths as wide as the grave, and like death, they are never satisfied. In their greed they have gathered up many nations and swallowed many peoples.
verses.textEnNasb: "Furthermore, wine betrays an arrogant man, So that he does not achieve his objective. He enlarges his appetite like Sheol, And he is like death, never satisfied. He also gathers to himself all the nations And collects to himself all the peoples.
verses.textEn: indeed, wine betrays him; he is arrogant and never at rest. Because he is as greedy as the grave and like death is never satisfied, he gathers to himself all the nations and takes captive all the peoples.

verses.textZh: 这些国民岂不都用譬喻、讽刺、暗语指着他们说： "那些滥得他人财物的， 满载别人抵押品的，有祸了！ 他们这样要到几时呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些国民岂不都用譬喻、讽刺、暗语指着他们说： "那些滥得他人财物的， 满载别人抵押品的，有祸了！ 他们这样要到几时呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 这些国的民岂不都要提起诗歌并俗语讥刺他说： 祸哉！迦勒底人，你增添不属自己的财物， 多多取人的当头，要到几时为止呢？
verses.textEnNiv: "Will not all of them taunt him with ridicule and scorn, saying, " ‘Woe to him who piles up stolen goods and makes himself wealthy by extortion! How long must this go on?’
verses.textEnEsv: Shall not all these take up their taunt against him, with scoffing and riddles for him, and say, "Woe to him who heaps up what is not his own— for how long?— and loads himself with pledges!"
verses.textEnNkjv: "Will not all these take up a proverb against him, And a taunting riddle against him, and say, ‘Woe to him who increases What is not his—how long? And to him who loads himself with many pledges’?
verses.textEnNlt: "But soon their captives will taunt them. They will mock them, saying, ‘What sorrow awaits you thieves! Now you will get what you deserve! You’ve become rich by extortion, but how much longer can this go on?’
verses.textEnNasb: "Will all of these not take up a song of ridicule against him, Even a saying and insinuations against him And say, ‘Woe to him who increases what is not his— For how long— And makes himself rich with debts!’
verses.textEn: "Will not all of them taunt him with ridicule and scorn, saying, " ‘Woe to him who piles up stolen goods and makes himself wealthy by extortion! How long must this go on?’

verses.textZh: 你的债主 岂不忽然起来？ 扰乱你的岂不醒起？ 你就成了他们的掳物。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的债主 岂不忽然起来？ 扰乱你的岂不醒起？ 你就成了他们的掳物。
verses.textZhCuv: 咬伤你的岂不忽然起来， 扰害你的岂不兴起， 你就作他们的掳物吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Will not your creditors suddenly arise? Will they not wake up and make you tremble? Then you will become their prey.
verses.textEnEsv: Will not your debtors suddenly arise, and those awake who will make you tremble? Then you will be spoil for them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Will not your creditors rise up suddenly? Will they not awaken who oppress you? And you will become their booty.
verses.textEnNlt: Suddenly, your debtors will take action. They will turn on you and take all you have, while you stand trembling and helpless.
verses.textEnNasb: "Will your creditors not rise up suddenly, And those who collect from you awaken? Indeed, you will become plunder for them.
verses.textEn: Will not your creditors suddenly arise? Will they not wake up and make you tremble? Then you will become their prey.

verses.textZh: 因你抢掠多国，杀人流血， 向全地各城和其中所有居民施行暴力， 所以剩下的人也必抢掠你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因你抢掠多国，杀人流血， 向全地各城和其中所有居民施行暴力， 所以剩下的人也必抢掠你。
verses.textZhCuv: 因你抢夺许多的国，杀人流血， 向国内的城并城中一切居民施行强暴， 所以各国剩下的民都必抢夺你。
verses.textEnNiv: Because you have plundered many nations, the peoples who are left will plunder you. For you have shed human blood; you have destroyed lands and cities and everyone in them.
verses.textEnEsv: Because you have plundered many nations, all the remnant of the peoples shall plunder you, for the blood of man and violence to the earth, to cities and all who dwell in them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Because you have plundered many nations, All the remnant of the people shall plunder you, Because of men’s blood And the violence of the land and the city, And of all who dwell in it.
verses.textEnNlt: Because you have plundered many nations, now all the survivors will plunder you. You committed murder throughout the countryside and filled the towns with violence.
verses.textEnNasb: "Since you have looted many nations, All the rest of the peoples will loot you— Because of human bloodshed and violence done to the land, To the town and all its inhabitants.
verses.textEn: Because you have plundered many nations, the peoples who are left will plunder you. For you have shed human blood; you have destroyed lands and cities and everyone in them.

verses.textZh: 你这为自己的家积聚不义之财， 在高处搭窝，以逃避灾害的， 有祸了！
verses.textZhCnvs: 你这为自己的家积聚不义之财， 在高处搭窝，以逃避灾害的， 有祸了！
verses.textZhCuv: 为本家积蓄不义之财、 在高处搭窝、指望免灾的有祸了！
verses.textEnNiv: "Woe to him who builds his house by unjust gain, setting his nest on high to escape the clutches of ruin!
verses.textEnEsv: "Woe to him who gets evil gain for his house, to set his nest on high, to be safe from the reach of harm!
verses.textEnNkjv: "Woe to him who covets evil gain for his house, That he may set his nest on high, That he may be delivered from the power of disaster!
verses.textEnNlt: "What sorrow awaits you who build big houses with money gained dishonestly! You believe your wealth will buy security, putting your family’s nest beyond the reach of danger.
verses.textEnNasb: "Woe to him who makes evil profit for his household, To put his nest on high, To be saved from the hand of catastrophe!
verses.textEn: "Woe to him who builds his house by unjust gain, setting his nest on high to escape the clutches of ruin!

verses.textZh: 你剪除多国的民，反害了自己； 你所谋算的，使你的家蒙羞。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你剪除多国的民，反害了自己； 你所谋算的，使你的家蒙羞。
verses.textZhCuv: 你图谋剪除多国的民，犯了罪， 使你的家蒙羞，自害己命。
verses.textEnNiv: You have plotted the ruin of many peoples, shaming your own house and forfeiting your life.
verses.textEnEsv: You have devised shame for your house by cutting off many peoples; you have forfeited your life.
verses.textEnNkjv: You give shameful counsel to your house, Cutting off many peoples, And sin against your soul.
verses.textEnNlt: But by the murders you committed, you have shamed your name and forfeited your lives.
verses.textEnNasb: "You have planned a shameful thing for your house By bringing many peoples to an end; So you are sinning against yourself.
verses.textEn: You have plotted the ruin of many peoples, shaming your own house and forfeiting your life.

verses.textZh: 石头必从墙里呼叫， 梁木必在树中应声。
verses.textZhCnvs: 石头必从墙里呼叫， 梁木必在树中应声。
verses.textZhCuv: 墙里的石头必呼叫； 房内的栋梁必应声。
verses.textEnNiv: The stones of the wall will cry out, and the beams of the woodwork will echo it.
verses.textEnEsv: For the stone will cry out from the wall, and the beam from the woodwork respond.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the stone will cry out from the wall, And the beam from the timbers will answer it.
verses.textEnNlt: The very stones in the walls cry out against you, and the beams in the ceilings echo the complaint.
verses.textEnNasb: "For the stone will cry out from the wall, And the rafter will answer it from the framework.
verses.textEn: The stones of the wall will cry out, and the beams of the woodwork will echo it.

verses.textZh: 你这用人血做城，凭邪恶立镇的， 有祸了！
verses.textZhCnvs: 你这用人血做城，凭邪恶立镇的， 有祸了！
verses.textZhCuv: 以人血建城、 以罪孽立邑的有祸了！
verses.textEnNiv: "Woe to him who builds a city with bloodshed and establishes a town by injustice!
verses.textEnEsv: "Woe to him who builds a town with blood and founds a city on iniquity!
verses.textEnNkjv: "Woe to him who builds a town with bloodshed, Who establishes a city by iniquity!
verses.textEnNlt: "What sorrow awaits you who build cities with money gained through murder and corruption!
verses.textEnNasb: "Woe to him who builds a city with bloodshed, And founds a town with violence!
verses.textEn: "Woe to him who builds a city with bloodshed and establishes a town by injustice!

verses.textZh: 众民劳碌得来的，被火焚烧； 列国辛劳而得的，终归无有。 这不都出于万军之耶和华吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 众民劳碌得来的，被火焚烧； 列国辛劳而得的，终归无有。 这不都出于万军之耶和华吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 众民所劳碌得来的被火焚烧， 列国由劳乏而得的归于虚空， 不都是出于万军之耶和华吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Has not the Lord Almighty determined that the people’s labor is only fuel for the fire, that the nations exhaust themselves for nothing?
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, is it not from the Lord of hosts that peoples labor merely for fire, and nations weary themselves for nothing?
verses.textEnNkjv: Behold, isit not of the Lord of hosts That the peoples labor to feed the fire, And nations weary themselves in vain?
verses.textEnNlt: Has not the Lord of Heaven’s Armies promised that the wealth of nations will turn to ashes? They work so hard, but all in vain!
verses.textEnNasb: "Is it not indeed from the Lord of armies That peoples labor merely for fire, And nations become weary for nothing?
verses.textEn: Has not the Lord Almighty determined that the people’s labor is only fuel for the fire, that the nations exhaust themselves for nothing?

verses.textZh: 认识耶和华之荣耀的知识，必充满全地，好象众水遮盖海洋一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 认识耶和华之荣耀的知识，必充满全地，好象众水遮盖海洋一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 认识耶和华荣耀的知识要充满遍地， 好像水充满洋海一般。
verses.textEnNiv: For the earth will be filled with the knowledge of the glory of the Lord as the waters cover the sea.
verses.textEnEsv: For the earth will be filled with the knowledge of the glory of the Lord as the waters cover the sea.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the earth will be filled With the knowledge of the glory of the Lord, As the waters cover the sea.
verses.textEnNlt: For as the waters fill the sea, the earth will be filled with an awareness of the glory of the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: "For the earth will be filled With the knowledge of the glory of the Lord, As the waters cover the sea.
verses.textEn: For the earth will be filled with the knowledge of the glory of the Lord as the waters cover the sea.

verses.textZh: 你这请邻舍喝酒，却把毒物混入， 使他醉倒， 为要见他赤裸的，有祸了！
verses.textZhCnvs: 你这请邻舍喝酒，却把毒物混入， 使他醉倒， 为要见他赤裸的，有祸了！
verses.textZhCuv: 给人酒喝、又加上毒物、 使他喝醉、好看见他下体的有祸了！
verses.textEnNiv: "Woe to him who gives drink to his neighbors, pouring it from the wineskin till they are drunk, so that he can gaze on their naked bodies!
verses.textEnEsv: "Woe to him who makes his neighbors drink— you pour out your wrath and make them drunk, in order to gaze at their nakedness!
verses.textEnNkjv: "Woe to him who gives drink to his neighbor, Pressing himto your bottle, Even to make him drunk, That you may look on his nakedness!
verses.textEnNlt: "What sorrow awaits you who make your neighbors drunk! You force your cup on them so you can gloat over their shameful nakedness.
verses.textEnNasb: "Woe to him who makes his neighbor drink; To you who mix in your venom even to make your neighbors drunk, So as to look at their genitalia!
verses.textEn: "Woe to him who gives drink to his neighbors, pouring it from the wineskin till they are drunk, so that he can gaze on their naked bodies!

verses.textZh: 你满有羞辱，没有尊荣，你也喝到露出下体来吧！ 耶和华右手的杯必传回来给你，使极大的羞辱取代你的尊荣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你满有羞辱，没有尊荣，你也喝到露出下体来吧！ 耶和华右手的杯必传回来给你，使极大的羞辱取代你的尊荣。
verses.textZhCuv: 你满受羞辱，不得荣耀； 你也喝吧，显出是未受割礼的！ 耶和华右手的杯必传到你那里； 你的荣耀就变为大大地羞辱。
verses.textEnNiv: You will be filled with shame instead of glory. Now it is your turn! Drink and let your nakedness be exposed ! The cup from the Lord ’s right hand is coming around to you, and disgrace will cover your glory.
verses.textEnEsv: You will have your fill of shame instead of glory. Drink, yourself, and show your uncircumcision! The cup in the Lord ’s right hand will come around to you, and utter shame will come upon your glory!
verses.textEnNkjv: You are filled with shame instead of glory. You also—drink! And be exposed as uncircumcised! The cup of the Lord’s right hand willbe turned against you, And utter shame will be on your glory.
verses.textEnNlt: But soon it will be your turn to be disgraced. Come, drink and be exposed! Drink from the cup of the Lord ’s judgment, and all your glory will be turned to shame.
verses.textEnNasb: "You will be filled with disgrace rather than honor. Drink, you yourself, and expose your own foreskin! The cup in the Lord’s right hand will come around to you, And utter disgrace will come upon your glory.
verses.textEn: You will be filled with shame instead of glory. Now it is your turn! Drink and let your nakedness be exposed ! The cup from the Lord ’s right hand is coming around to you, and disgrace will cover your glory.

verses.textZh: 因你向黎巴嫩使用暴力，杀灭惊吓野兽；又杀人流血，向全地各城和其中所有居民施行暴力，就必受到报应 。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因你向黎巴嫩使用暴力，杀灭惊吓野兽；又杀人流血，向全地各城和其中所有居民施行暴力，就必受到报应 。
verses.textZhCuv: 你向黎巴嫩行强暴与残害 惊吓野兽的事必遮盖你； 因你杀人流血， 向国内的城并城中一切居民施行强暴。
verses.textEnNiv: The violence you have done to Lebanon will overwhelm you, and your destruction of animals will terrify you. For you have shed human blood; you have destroyed lands and cities and everyone in them.
verses.textEnEsv: The violence done to Lebanon will overwhelm you, as will the destruction of the beasts that terrified them, for the blood of man and violence to the earth, to cities and all who dwell in them.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the violence doneto Lebanon will cover you, And the plunder of beasts which made them afraid, Because of men’s blood And the violence of the land and the city, And of all who dwell in it.
verses.textEnNlt: You cut down the forests of Lebanon. Now you will be cut down. You destroyed the wild animals, so now their terror will be yours. You committed murder throughout the countryside and filled the towns with violence.
verses.textEnNasb: "For the violence done to Lebanon will overwhelm you, And the devastation of its animals by which you terrified them, Because of human bloodshed and violence done to the land, To the town and all its inhabitants.
verses.textEn: The violence you have done to Lebanon will overwhelm you, and your destruction of animals will terrify you. For you have shed human blood; you have destroyed lands and cities and everyone in them.

verses.textZh: 雕刻的像有甚么用处呢？不过是匠人雕刻出来的； 铸造的像、虚假的教师，有甚么用处呢？ 匠人竟倚靠自己所做，那不能说话的假神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 雕刻的像有甚么用处呢？不过是匠人雕刻出来的； 铸造的像、虚假的教师，有甚么用处呢？ 匠人竟倚靠自己所做，那不能说话的假神。
verses.textZhCuv: 雕刻的偶像，人将它刻出来， 有什么益处呢？ 铸造的偶像就是虚谎的师傅。 制造者倚靠这哑巴偶像有什么益处呢？
verses.textEnNiv: "Of what value is an idol carved by a craftsman? Or an image that teaches lies? For the one who makes it trusts in his own creation; he makes idols that cannot speak.
verses.textEnEsv: "What profit is an idol when its maker has shaped it, a metal image, a teacher of lies? For its maker trusts in his own creation when he makes speechless idols!
verses.textEnNkjv: "What profit is the image, that its maker should carve it, The molded image, a teacher of lies, That the maker of its mold should trust in it, To make mute idols?
verses.textEnNlt: "What good is an idol carved by man, or a cast image that deceives you? How foolish to trust in your own creation— a god that can’t even talk!
verses.textEnNasb: "What benefit is a carved image when its maker has carved it, Or a cast metal image, a teacher of falsehood? For its maker trusts in his own handiwork When he fashions speechless idols.
verses.textEn: "Of what value is an idol carved by a craftsman? Or an image that teaches lies? For the one who makes it trusts in his own creation; he makes idols that cannot speak.

verses.textZh: 你这对木头说"起来"， 对哑石说"醒吧"的人，有祸了！ 它怎能教导你呢？ 看哪！它包金镶银，里面却全无气息。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你这对木头说"起来"， 对哑石说"醒吧"的人，有祸了！ 它怎能教导你呢？ 看哪！它包金镶银，里面却全无气息。
verses.textZhCuv: 对木偶说：醒起！ 对哑巴石像说：起来！那人有祸了！ 这个还能教训人吗？ 看哪，是包裹金银的，其中毫无气息。
verses.textEnNiv: Woe to him who says to wood, ‘Come to life!’ Or to lifeless stone, ‘Wake up!’ Can it give guidance? It is covered with gold and silver; there is no breath in it."
verses.textEnEsv: Woe to him who says to a wooden thing, Awake; to a silent stone, Arise! Can this teach? Behold, it is overlaid with gold and silver, and there is no breath at all in it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Woe to him who says to wood, ‘Awake!’ To silent stone, ‘Arise! It shall teach!’ Behold, it is overlaid with gold and silver, Yet in it there is no breath at all.
verses.textEnNlt: What sorrow awaits you who say to wooden idols, ‘Wake up and save us!’ To speechless stone images you say, ‘Rise up and teach us!’ Can an idol tell you what to do? They may be overlaid with gold and silver, but they are lifeless inside.
verses.textEnNasb: "Woe to him who says to a piece of wood, ‘Awake!’ To a mute stone, ‘Arise!’ That is your teacher? Behold, it is overlaid with gold and silver, Yet there is no breath at all inside it.
verses.textEn: Woe to him who says to wood, ‘Come to life!’ Or to lifeless stone, ‘Wake up!’ Can it give guidance? It is covered with gold and silver; there is no breath in it."

verses.textZh: 然而耶和华在他的圣殿里，全地当在他面前肃静。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然而耶和华在他的圣殿里，全地当在他面前肃静。
verses.textZhCuv: 惟耶和华在他的圣殿中； 全地的人都当在他面前肃敬静默。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord is in his holy temple; let all the earth be silent before him.
verses.textEnEsv: But the Lord is in his holy temple; let all the earth keep silence before him."
verses.textEnNkjv: "But the Lord is in His holy temple. Let all the earth keep silence before Him."
verses.textEnNlt: But the Lord is in his holy Temple. Let all the earth be silent before him."
verses.textEnNasb: "But the Lord is in His holy temple. Let all the earth be silent before Him."
verses.textEn: The Lord is in his holy temple; let all the earth be silent before him.

verses.textZh: 哈巴谷先知的祷告，配激动的音调。
verses.textZhCnvs: 哈巴谷先知的祷告，配激动的音调。
verses.textZhCuv: 先知哈巴谷的祷告，调用流离歌。
verses.textEnNiv: A prayer of Habakkuk the prophet. On shigionoth.
verses.textEnEsv: A prayer of Habakkuk the prophet, according to Shigionoth.
verses.textEnNkjv: A prayer of Habakkuk the prophet, on Shigionoth.
verses.textEnNlt: This prayer was sung by the prophet Habakkuk :
verses.textEnNasb: A prayer of Habakkuk the prophet, according to Shigionoth.
verses.textEn: A prayer of Habakkuk the prophet. On shigionoth.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！我听见你的声音，惧怕你的作为； 求你在这些年间复兴，在这些年间彰显， 发怒的时候以怜悯为怀。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！我听见你的声音，惧怕你的作为； 求你在这些年间复兴，在这些年间彰显， 发怒的时候以怜悯为怀。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，我听见你的名声 就惧怕。 耶和华啊，求你在这些年间复兴你的作为， 在这些年间显明出来； 在发怒的时候以怜悯为念。
verses.textEnNiv: Lord , I have heard of your fame; I stand in awe of your deeds, Lord . Repeat them in our day, in our time make them known; in wrath remember mercy.
verses.textEnEsv: O Lord , I have heard the report of you, and your work, O Lord , do I fear. In the midst of the years revive it; in the midst of the years make it known; in wrath remember mercy.
verses.textEnNkjv: O Lord, I have heard Your speech and was afraid; O Lord, revive Your work in the midst of the years! In the midst of the years make it known; In wrath remember mercy.
verses.textEnNlt: I have heard all about you, Lord . I am filled with awe by your amazing works. In this time of our deep need, help us again as you did in years gone by. And in your anger, remember your mercy.
verses.textEnNasb: Lord, I have heard the report about You, and I was afraid. Lord, revive Your work in the midst of the years, In the midst of the years make it known. In anger remember mercy.
verses.textEn: Lord , I have heard of your fame; I stand in awe of your deeds, Lord . Repeat them in our day, in our time make them known; in wrath remember mercy.

verses.textZh: 神由提幔而来，圣者从巴兰山临到。 他的荣光弥漫穹苍，赞美他的声音响彻大地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神由提幔而来，圣者从巴兰山临到。 他的荣光弥漫穹苍，赞美他的声音响彻大地。
verses.textZhCuv: 神从提幔而来； 圣者从巴兰山临到。 （细拉） 他的荣光遮蔽诸天； 颂赞充满大地。
verses.textEnNiv: God came from Teman, the Holy One from Mount Paran. His glory covered the heavens and his praise filled the earth.
verses.textEnEsv: God came from Teman, and the Holy One from Mount Paran. Selah His splendor covered the heavens, and the earth was full of his praise.
verses.textEnNkjv: God came from Teman, The Holy One from Mount Paran. Selah His glory covered the heavens, And the earth was full of His praise.
verses.textEnNlt: I see God moving across the deserts from Edom, the Holy One coming from Mount Paran. His brilliant splendor fills the heavens, and the earth is filled with his praise.
verses.textEnNasb: God comes from Teman, And the Holy One from Mount Paran. Selah His splendor covers the heavens, And the earth is full of His praise.
verses.textEn: God came from Teman, the Holy One from Mount Paran. His glory covered the heavens and his praise filled the earth.

verses.textZh: 他的辉煌如光，手中四射光芒，就在其中隐藏着能力。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的辉煌如光，手中四射光芒，就在其中隐藏着能力。
verses.textZhCuv: 他的辉煌如同日光； 从他手里射出光线， 在其中藏着他的能力。
verses.textEnNiv: His splendor was like the sunrise; rays flashed from his hand, where his power was hidden.
verses.textEnEsv: His brightness was like the light; rays flashed from his hand; and there he veiled his power.
verses.textEnNkjv: His brightness was like the light; He had rays flashing from His hand, And there His power was hidden.
verses.textEnNlt: His coming is as brilliant as the sunrise. Rays of light flash from his hands, where his awesome power is hidden.
verses.textEnNasb: His radiance is like the sunlight; He has rays flashing from His hand, And the hiding of His might is there.
verses.textEn: His splendor was like the sunrise; rays flashed from his hand, where his power was hidden.

verses.textZh: 瘟疫在他面前行走，灾病在他脚下发出。
verses.textZhCnvs: 瘟疫在他面前行走，灾病在他脚下发出。
verses.textZhCuv: 在他前面有瘟疫流行； 在他脚下有热症发出。
verses.textEnNiv: Plague went before him; pestilence followed his steps.
verses.textEnEsv: Before him went pestilence, and plague followed at his heels.
verses.textEnNkjv: Before Him went pestilence, And fever followed at His feet.
verses.textEnNlt: Pestilence marches before him; plague follows close behind.
verses.textEnNasb: Before Him goes plague, And plague comes forth after Him.
verses.textEn: Plague went before him; pestilence followed his steps.

verses.textZh: 他站立，震撼全地； 他观看，惊散列国。 永在的山崩裂，长存的岭塌陷； 他的道路存到永远。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他站立，震撼全地； 他观看，惊散列国。 永在的山崩裂，长存的岭塌陷； 他的道路存到永远。
verses.textZhCuv: 他站立，量了大地 ， 观看，赶散万民。 永久的山崩裂； 长存的岭塌陷； 他的作为与古时一样。
verses.textEnNiv: He stood, and shook the earth; he looked, and made the nations tremble. The ancient mountains crumbled and the age-old hills collapsed— but he marches on forever.
verses.textEnEsv: He stood and measured the earth; he looked and shook the nations; then the eternal mountains were scattered; the everlasting hills sank low. His were the everlasting ways.
verses.textEnNkjv: He stood and measured the earth; He looked and startled the nations. And the everlasting mountains were scattered, The perpetual hills bowed. His ways are everlasting.
verses.textEnNlt: When he stops, the earth shakes. When he looks, the nations tremble. He shatters the everlasting mountains and levels the eternal hills. He is the Eternal One!
verses.textEnNasb: He stood and caused the earth to shudder; He looked and caused the nations to jump. Yes, the everlasting mountains were shattered, The ancient hills collapsed. His paths are everlasting.
verses.textEn: He stood, and shook the earth; he looked, and made the nations tremble. The ancient mountains crumbled and the age-old hills collapsed— but he marches on forever.

verses.textZh: 我看见古珊的帐棚遭难，米甸地的帐幕惊惶。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我看见古珊的帐棚遭难，米甸地的帐幕惊惶。
verses.textZhCuv: 我见古珊的帐棚遭难， 米甸的幔子战兢。
verses.textEnNiv: I saw the tents of Cushan in distress, the dwellings of Midian in anguish.
verses.textEnEsv: I saw the tents of Cushan in affliction; the curtains of the land of Midian did tremble.
verses.textEnNkjv: I saw the tents of Cushan in affliction; The curtains of the land of Midian trembled.
verses.textEnNlt: I see the people of Cushan in distress, and the nation of Midian trembling in terror.
verses.textEnNasb: I saw the tents of Cushan under distress, The tent curtains of the land of Midian were trembling.
verses.textEn: I saw the tents of Cushan in distress, the dwellings of Midian in anguish.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！你骑上你的马，乘驾得胜的战车， 难道是恼怒江河、向江河发怒、向海洋泄愤？
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！你骑上你的马，乘驾得胜的战车， 难道是恼怒江河、向江河发怒、向海洋泄愤？
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，你乘在马上， 坐在得胜的车上， 岂是不喜悦江河、 向江河发怒气、 向洋海发愤恨吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Were you angry with the rivers, Lord ? Was your wrath against the streams? Did you rage against the sea when you rode your horses and your chariots to victory?
verses.textEnEsv: Was your wrath against the rivers, O Lord ? Was your anger against the rivers, or your indignation against the sea, when you rode on your horses, on your chariot of salvation?
verses.textEnNkjv: O Lord, were You displeased with the rivers, Was Your anger against the rivers, Was Your wrath against the sea, That You rode on Your horses, Your chariots of salvation?
verses.textEnNlt: Was it in anger, Lord , that you struck the rivers and parted the sea? Were you displeased with them? No, you were sending your chariots of salvation!
verses.textEnNasb: Did the Lord rage against the rivers, Or was Your anger against the rivers, Or was Your rage against the sea, That You rode on Your horses, On Your chariots of salvation?
verses.textEn: Were you angry with the rivers, Lord ? Was your wrath against the streams? Did you rage against the sea when you rode your horses and your chariots to victory?

verses.textZh: 你的弓显露，你的箭上弦。 你裂开大地为江河。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的弓显露，你的箭上弦。 你裂开大地为江河。
verses.textZhCuv: 你的弓全然显露， 向众支派所起的誓都是可信的。 （细拉） 你以江河分开大地。
verses.textEnNiv: You uncovered your bow, you called for many arrows. You split the earth with rivers;
verses.textEnEsv: You stripped the sheath from your bow, calling for many arrows. Selah You split the earth with rivers.
verses.textEnNkjv: Your bow was made quite ready; Oaths were sworn over Your arrows. Selah You divided the earth with rivers.
verses.textEnNlt: You brandished your bow and your quiver of arrows. You split open the earth with flowing rivers.
verses.textEnNasb: You removed Your bow from its holder, The arrows of Your word were sworn. Selah You divided the earth with rivers.
verses.textEn: You uncovered your bow, you called for many arrows. You split the earth with rivers;

verses.textZh: 诸山见你而颤抖， 众水暴流而过； 深渊发声，举手高扬。
verses.textZhCnvs: 诸山见你而颤抖， 众水暴流而过； 深渊发声，举手高扬。
verses.textZhCuv: 山岭见你，无不战惧； 大水氾滥过去， 深渊发声，汹涌翻腾 。
verses.textEnNiv: the mountains saw you and writhed. Torrents of water swept by; the deep roared and lifted its waves on high.
verses.textEnEsv: The mountains saw you and writhed; the raging waters swept on; the deep gave forth its voice; it lifted its hands on high.
verses.textEnNkjv: The mountains saw You and trembled; The overflowing of the water passed by. The deep uttered its voice, And lifted its hands on high.
verses.textEnNlt: The mountains watched and trembled. Onward swept the raging waters. The mighty deep cried out, lifting its hands in submission.
verses.textEnNasb: The mountains saw You and quaked; The downpour of waters swept by. The deep raised its voice, It lifted high its hands.
verses.textEn: the mountains saw you and writhed. Torrents of water swept by; the deep roared and lifted its waves on high.

verses.textZh: 日月停在本位， 你的箭发射如光； 你的矛闪烁辉耀。
verses.textZhCnvs: 日月停在本位， 你的箭发射如光； 你的矛闪烁辉耀。
verses.textZhCuv: 因你的箭射出发光， 你的枪闪出光耀， 日月都在本宫停住。
verses.textEnNiv: Sun and moon stood still in the heavens at the glint of your flying arrows, at the lightning of your flashing spear.
verses.textEnEsv: The sun and moon stood still in their place at the light of your arrows as they sped, at the flash of your glittering spear.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sun and moon stood still in their habitation; At the light of Your arrows they went, At the shining of Your glittering spear.
verses.textEnNlt: The sun and moon stood still in the sky as your brilliant arrows flew and your glittering spear flashed.
verses.textEnNasb: Sun and moon stood in their lofty places; They went away at the light of Your arrows, At the radiance of Your flashing spear.
verses.textEn: Sun and moon stood still in the heavens at the glint of your flying arrows, at the lightning of your flashing spear.

verses.textZh: 你激愤践踏全地，你怀怒打碎列国。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你激愤践踏全地，你怀怒打碎列国。
verses.textZhCuv: 你发忿恨通行大地， 发怒气责打列国，如同打粮。
verses.textEnNiv: In wrath you strode through the earth and in anger you threshed the nations.
verses.textEnEsv: You marched through the earth in fury; you threshed the nations in anger.
verses.textEnNkjv: You marched through the land in indignation; You trampled the nations in anger.
verses.textEnNlt: You marched across the land in anger and trampled the nations in your fury.
verses.textEnNasb: In indignation You marched through the earth; In anger You trampled the nations.
verses.textEn: In wrath you strode through the earth and in anger you threshed the nations.

verses.textZh: 你出来救拔子民，拯救你所膏立的。 你击打恶人的房顶， 使根基全然显露 。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你出来救拔子民，拯救你所膏立的。 你击打恶人的房顶， 使根基全然显露 。
verses.textZhCuv: 你出来要拯救你的百姓， 拯救你的受膏者， 打破恶人家长的头， 露出他的脚 ，直到颈项。 （细拉）
verses.textEnNiv: You came out to deliver your people, to save your anointed one. You crushed the leader of the land of wickedness, you stripped him from head to foot.
verses.textEnEsv: You went out for the salvation of your people, for the salvation of your anointed. You crushed the head of the house of the wicked, laying him bare from thigh to neck. Selah
verses.textEnNkjv: You went forth for the salvation of Your people, For salvation with Your Anointed. You struck the head from the house of the wicked, By laying bare from foundation to neck. Selah
verses.textEnNlt: You went out to rescue your chosen people, to save your anointed ones. You crushed the heads of the wicked and stripped their bones from head to toe.
verses.textEnNasb: You went forth for the salvation of Your people, For the salvation of Your anointed. You smashed the head of the house of evil To uncover him from foot to neck. Selah
verses.textEn: You came out to deliver your people, to save your anointed one. You crushed the leader of the land of wickedness, you stripped him from head to foot.

verses.textZh: 你用他的枪，刺透他战士的头。 他们来如暴风，把我们驱散。 他们的喜好，是暗中吞噬穷人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你用他的枪，刺透他战士的头。 他们来如暴风，把我们驱散。 他们的喜好，是暗中吞噬穷人。
verses.textZhCuv: 你用敌人的戈矛刺透他战士的头； 他们来如旋风，要将我们分散。 他们所喜爱的是暗中吞吃贫民。
verses.textEnNiv: With his own spear you pierced his head when his warriors stormed out to scatter us, gloating as though about to devour the wretched who were in hiding.
verses.textEnEsv: You pierced with his own arrows the heads of his warriors, who came like a whirlwind to scatter me, rejoicing as if to devour the poor in secret.
verses.textEnNkjv: You thrust through with his own arrows The head of his villages. They came out like a whirlwind to scatter me; Their rejoicing was like feasting on the poor in secret.
verses.textEnNlt: With his own weapons, you destroyed the chief of those who rushed out like a whirlwind, thinking Israel would be easy prey.
verses.textEnNasb: You pierced with his own arrows The head of his leaders. They stormed in to scatter us; Their arrogance was like those Who devour the oppressed in secret.
verses.textEn: With his own spear you pierced his head when his warriors stormed out to scatter us, gloating as though about to devour the wretched who were in hiding.

verses.textZh: 你乘马驰骋海上，大水汹涌翻腾。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你乘马驰骋海上，大水汹涌翻腾。
verses.textZhCuv: 你乘马践踏红海， 就是践踏汹涌的大水。
verses.textEnNiv: You trampled the sea with your horses, churning the great waters.
verses.textEnEsv: You trampled the sea with your horses, the surging of mighty waters.
verses.textEnNkjv: You walked through the sea with Your horses, Through the heap of great waters.
verses.textEnNlt: You trampled the sea with your horses, and the mighty waters piled high.
verses.textEnNasb: You trampled on the sea with Your horses, On the foam of many waters.
verses.textEn: You trampled the sea with your horses, churning the great waters.

verses.textZh: 我一听见，就全身发抖； 因这声音，我嘴唇震颤。 腐烂侵蚀我骨，我在站立之地战兢。 我静候灾难之日，犯境的民上来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我一听见，就全身发抖； 因这声音，我嘴唇震颤。 腐烂侵蚀我骨，我在站立之地战兢。 我静候灾难之日，犯境的民上来。
verses.textZhCuv: 我听见耶和华的声音， 身体战兢，嘴唇发颤， 骨中朽烂； 我在所立之处战兢。 我只可安静等候灾难之日临到， 犯境之民上来。
verses.textEnNiv: I heard and my heart pounded, my lips quivered at the sound; decay crept into my bones, and my legs trembled. Yet I will wait patiently for the day of calamity to come on the nation invading us.
verses.textEnEsv: I hear, and my body trembles; my lips quiver at the sound; rottenness enters into my bones; my legs tremble beneath me. Yet I will quietly wait for the day of trouble to come upon people who invade us.
verses.textEnNkjv: When I heard, my body trembled; My lips quivered at the voice; Rottenness entered my bones; And I trembled in myself, That I might rest in the day of trouble. When he comes up to the people, He will invade them with his troops.
verses.textEnNlt: I trembled inside when I heard this; my lips quivered with fear. My legs gave way beneath me, and I shook in terror. I will wait quietly for the coming day when disaster will strike the people who invade us.
verses.textEnNasb: I heard, and my inner parts trembled; At the sound, my lips quivered. Decay enters my bones, And in my place I tremble; Because I must wait quietly for the day of distress, For the people to arise who will attack us.
verses.textEn: I heard and my heart pounded, my lips quivered at the sound; decay crept into my bones, and my legs trembled. Yet I will wait patiently for the day of calamity to come on the nation invading us.

verses.textZh: 无花果树纵不发芽，葡萄树不结果， 橄榄树无所出，田里无收成， 圈内的羊被剪除，棚里也没有牛，
verses.textZhCnvs: 无花果树纵不发芽，葡萄树不结果， 橄榄树无所出，田里无收成， 圈内的羊被剪除，棚里也没有牛，
verses.textZhCuv: 虽然无花果树不发旺， 葡萄树不结果， 橄榄树也不效力， 田地不出粮食， 圈中绝了羊， 棚内也没有牛；
verses.textEnNiv: Though the fig tree does not bud and there are no grapes on the vines, though the olive crop fails and the fields produce no food, though there are no sheep in the pen and no cattle in the stalls,
verses.textEnEsv: Though the fig tree should not blossom, nor fruit be on the vines, the produce of the olive fail and the fields yield no food, the flock be cut off from the fold and there be no herd in the stalls,
verses.textEnNkjv: Though the fig tree may not blossom, Nor fruit be on the vines; Though the labor of the olive may fail, And the fields yield no food; Though the flock may be cut off from the fold, And there be no herd in the stalls—
verses.textEnNlt: Even though the fig trees have no blossoms, and there are no grapes on the vines; even though the olive crop fails, and the fields lie empty and barren; even though the flocks die in the fields, and the cattle barns are empty,
verses.textEnNasb: Even if the fig tree does not blossom, And there is no fruit on the vines, If the yield of the olive fails, And the fields produce no food, Even if the flock disappears from the fold, And there are no cattle in the stalls,
verses.textEn: Though the fig tree does not bud and there are no grapes on the vines, though the olive crop fails and the fields produce no food, though there are no sheep in the pen and no cattle in the stalls,

verses.textZh: 我却要因耶和华欢喜， 以救我的神为乐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我却要因耶和华欢喜， 以救我的神为乐。
verses.textZhCuv: 然而，我要因耶和华欢欣， 因救我的神喜乐。
verses.textEnNiv: yet I will rejoice in the Lord , I will be joyful in God my Savior.
verses.textEnEsv: yet I will rejoice in the Lord ; I will take joy in the God of my salvation.
verses.textEnNkjv: Yet I will rejoice in the Lord, I will joy in the God of my salvation.
verses.textEnNlt: yet I will rejoice in the Lord ! I will be joyful in the God of my salvation!
verses.textEnNasb: Yet I will triumph in the Lord, I will rejoice in the God of my salvation.
verses.textEn: yet I will rejoice in the Lord , I will be joyful in God my Savior.

verses.textZh: 主耶和华是我的力量， 他使我的脚快如母鹿的蹄，在高地上行走。 交诗班长，用丝弦的乐器伴奏。
verses.textZhCnvs: 主耶和华是我的力量， 他使我的脚快如母鹿的蹄，在高地上行走。 交诗班长，用丝弦的乐器伴奏。
verses.textZhCuv: 主耶和华是我的力量； 他使我的脚快如母鹿的蹄， 又使我稳行在高处。 这歌交与伶长，用丝弦的乐器。
verses.textEnNiv: The Sovereign Lord is my strength; he makes my feet like the feet of a deer, he enables me to tread on the heights. For the director of music. On my stringed instruments.
verses.textEnEsv: God , the Lord, is my strength; he makes my feet like the deer’s; he makes me tread on my high places. To the choirmaster: with stringed instruments.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord God is my strength; He will make my feet like deer’s feet, And He will make me walk on my high hills. To the Chief Musician. With my stringed instruments.
verses.textEnNlt: The Sovereign Lord is my strength! He makes me as surefooted as a deer, able to tread upon the heights. (For the choir director: This prayer is to be accompanied by stringed instruments.)
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord God is my strength, And He has made my feet like deer’s feet, And has me walk on my high places. For the choir director, on my stringed instruments.
verses.textEn: The Sovereign Lord is my strength; he makes my feet like the feet of a deer, he enables me to tread on the heights. For the director of music. On my stringed instruments.
